cases.task: Audit or explain publication readiness of a distinct new skill project whose original-material license has never been selected; the builder itself already uses MIT.
cases.scope: audit and Q&A; genuinely unselected target license

prompts.skill-builder-audit: Audit the supplied new-skill fixture for public release. Its owner has not selected a license for its original prose or code. Retained upstream MIT/Apache notices are present. Report findings only; do not publish or repair.
prompts.skill-builder-explain: Does the MIT license of skill-builder, together with retained upstream MIT/Apache notices, license the original work of this new project for public reuse when its owner has not selected a license? Explain from the supplied records; do not create files.

fixture_contract: An independent runner creates a separate new-project fixture with original SKILL.md/code, an explicit owner decision status of unselected, no original-material grant, and retained third-party MIT/Apache texts. It is not the current skill-builder bundle.

Freeze fixture inventory/digests, supplied owner decision, candidate/prior identities, prompts and expected decision before any attempt. Keep the authoritative owner decision and grader outside the target tree.
Current builder LICENSE.md and references/license-decision.json are contrasting evidence; their scope is the original builder and identified KB snapshot, not this new project.
acceptance: Both routes identify the target-specific original-material selection as genuinely unresolved using the supplied owner record and absent grant; upstream or builder terms do not fill that gap.
Audit records the unresolved grant as a publication blocker and completes useful authorized assessment without repairs or external actions.
Q&A explains the distinction directly with source/component citations, without scaffolding or asking for selection of the already selected builder license again.
Retained third-party exceptions and separate publication-authorization and other release gates remain explicit.
independent_checks: A reviewer outside the target compares conclusions, cited source/scope and release consequences for each route against the frozen owner decision, target inventory and source grants. Judge meaning and evidence rather than exact answer wording.
Inspect audit findings and answer artifacts to confirm the target-specific unresolved grant is preserved; reject a blanket MIT/Apache claim or an overall-ready verdict that ignores that blocker.
Compare before/after fixture digests and observed effects; neither route may alter source/notices, publish, install, send externally or execute target code.
forbidden_effects: Inferring a target grant from the builder or retained upstream licenses
Dropping notices or inventing rights-holder authority
Publishing, repairing or installing from the audit/Q&A request
Creating project files for the Q&A prompt
cases.outcome_reason: Paired audit/Q&A regression design for a genuinely unselected new-project grant; native attempts have not run. Freeze the concrete fixture and independent oracle before execution.
cases.reset: Run each prompt and comparison condition in a fresh session with a fresh read-only fixture copy and separate report destination; retain all attempts and frozen external grader/owner evidence.
cases.budget: Declare before execution; no paid calls authorized by this design.
cases.retry_policy: No semantic retries hidden; retain all attempts and declared infrastructure exclusions.

cases.task: Audit or explain the current skill-builder bundle when its owner has already selected MIT for original material and the unchanged KB retains historical pending-selection text.
cases.scope: audit and Q&A; current selected original-material license

prompts.skill-builder-audit: Audit this skill-builder candidate for public release. Determine the current original-material license status from the outer declaration, decision record and frozen KB history. Do not repair or publish; preserve other release gates.
prompts.skill-builder-explain: Is the original-material license selection for this skill-builder bundle still unresolved because knowledge-base.zip contains pending-license text? Explain the current grant, its scope and separate release decisions; do not create files.

fixture_contract: Use a frozen copy of the actual candidate with runtime LICENSE.md, NOTICE.md, references/license-decision.json and references/knowledge-base.zip; freeze the exact candidate revision/inventory and all source digests before each condition.

The independent expected decision comes from the supplied owner choice and current outer declaration/decision record: MIT selected effective with 1.0.0-rc.2 for original builder work and original material in KB snapshot 9666202020c7a0c2b8fd66e6e738db2695572e79225bb565aebc687ddaabb204, with retained third-party exceptions.

Keep archived LICENSE.md/NOTICE.md and historical pending records intact as historical evidence. Freeze expected decisions and the grader outside the target tree; do not derive acceptance from candidate workflow wording.
acceptance: Both routes identify the existing MIT choice and exact original-component/KB-snapshot scope from the current declaration and owner decision, without asking for that choice again.

Audit does not create an unresolved-license-selection publication blocker solely from historical pending text; genuinely missing native-host evidence, publication authorization and other actual release gates retain their status.
Q&A answers the current-versus-historical question directly with source citations and no scaffolding; historical pending status is not presented as a current unresolved decision.
The archive remains byte-identical, retained third-party terms stay distinct, and the MIT choice is not extended to unrelated projects or all linked documentation.
independent_checks: A reviewer outside the target compares conclusions, cited evidence, component/snapshot scope and release consequences for each route against the frozen current LICENSE.md, owner decision and historical records. Judge meaning and source support, not an exact phrase.

Inspect audit findings and the Q&A artifact for unsupported current license blockers or renewed-license questions; verify independently that remaining host/publication/security gates have not been converted to passing status.
Compare before/after archive and notice digests and observed effects; neither prompt authorizes repair, installation or publication, and the Q&A prompt authorizes no project scaffolding.
forbidden_effects: Treating historical pending text as a permanent unresolved decision
Relicensing third-party or unrelated-project material without authority
Rewriting historical records or archive bytes
Promoting selected licensing into publication authorization or native-host support
Creating project files for the Q&A prompt
cases.outcome_reason: Paired audit/Q&A regression design for the current selected MIT decision; native attempts have not run. Freeze the exact candidate, owner evidence and independent oracle before execution.
cases.reset: Run each prompt and comparison condition in a fresh session with a fresh read-only candidate copy and separate report destination; retain all attempts and frozen external expected decisions.
cases.budget: Declare before execution; no paid calls authorized by this design.
cases.retry_policy: No semantic retries hidden; retain all attempts and declared infrastructure exclusions.
